# A Dark Cave

> A text-based survival and settlement-building incremental. Play for free in your browser on desktop or mobile. Steam demo available; full Steam release planned 27 October 2026.

- Site: https://a-dark-cave.com
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4882240/A_Dark_Cave/
- itch.io: https://a-dark-cave.itch.io/a-dark-cave
- Full facts: https://a-dark-cave.com/llms-full.txt

## Key facts

- Developer: Julian Bauer
- Genre: incremental, text-based survival, settlement builder (semi-idle + active; not a clicker, not a second-screen idle)
- Platforms: web browser (desktop and mobile browsers). Steam (Windows) with a free demo. Not on the App Store or Google Play.
- Price: play for free in the browser. Steam is a paid game with a free demo.
- Comps: A Dark Room, Kittens Game, The Ensign, Universal Paperclips, Candy Box, Level 13, KEROS-9
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese, Russian
- Contact: support@a-dark-cave.com
